note: A maker-and-games weekend in the Austin suburbs — a craft fair plus tabletop, chess and story clubs

picks.reason: Maker Fest craft fair at Cedar Park — the weekend's biggest all-ages making event
Ruan Sisters perform traditional instruments in the Round Rock lobby — live music, free to walk up
Library on the Go pops up at Meadow Lake Park — stories outdoors in the first real fall air
Pokémon Club for the card-trading crowd — bring a deck and trade
Old School D&D for ages 10-15 — a real tabletop adventure, not a read-aloud
Sunday chess open play — all levels welcome, boards provided
Story Club for ages 6-8 — read, then talk books with other kids
